name: Fujiwara Yasuaki
source: While being hospitalized due to broken arms after helping a child from accident, he was taken care of by his best friend's mother who works as nurse and also knew him since childhood. As the time went on, with his arms were still useless, he had no choice but to have her helping him in calming down his lust which kept piling up from long hospitalization period. However, little did he know this would become the trigger of his first love.
